entries.title: Germany’s second China shock
entries.summary: Mark Leonard welcomes Janka Oertel and Andrew Small to discuss how China’s industrial rise is shaking Germany—and Europe’s—economic foundations

entries.title: In the bear’s paw: How Europeans can loosen Russia’s grip on Belarus
entries.summary: Russia’s growing military intervention in Belarus poses a frontline security challenge for Europe. The EU needs to develop a more pragmatic strategy based on protecting its eastern border and shaping Minsk’s autonomy away from Moscow.

entries.title: Cold comfort: What China can teach Europe about adaptation
entries.summary: Europe is learning to adapt to a hotter climate. It should take the same approach to economic dependencies: manage the consequences, but also change the conditions that created them

entries.title: Buzzkill: How to defend Europe against drones
entries.summary: Drone warfare in Europe is no longer tomorrow’s problem. The continent is under attack by drones today, and the threat is not isolated in the east.
